verdict.rationale: Discord's official REST/Gateway API supports bot tokens and OAuth2 bearer tokens scoped to specific permissions, allowing an agent (bot) to read and post channel messages via documented endpoints and real-time Gateway events. missing for 10: no independent hands-on confirmation of an AI agent specifically using scoped tokens for message read/post, and no explicit documentation of granular message-read/post scopes beyond general bot/OAuth2 token mechanics.
